The ACA’s premium tax credits are a band-aid on a bullet wound. The real issue? A healthcare system rigged by Big Pharma monopolies, Medicaid fraud, and bureaucratic bloat. Letting credits expire isn’t the problem—it’s the symptom.

The Fair Tax Act (H.R. 25) guts the IRS and ends hidden taxes, putting money back in Americans’ pockets so they can choose care, not subsidies. Medicaid’s collapse isn’t from “cuts”—it’s from millions added illegally, draining resources from citizens.

Fix the rot: audit fraud, break pharma’s grip, enforce borders. Permanent subsidies just fund failure.

In 2019, I chaired a taskforce to examine why suicide was on the rise for certain groups of children and how we could reverse this trend. 

We identified mental health screenings as a solution that increases the likelihood of connecting students with the services that they may need, mental health or otherwise. Screening can identify problems that may not be immediately apparent, but can lead to problems down the road.
